name: 企业运营中台
positioning: 适合经营驾驶舱、客户运营、订单管理和团队协作类网页 Demo

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.font_family: system sans-serif with Chinese platform fonts
design_tokens.shadow_style: flat bordered cards with restrained overlays

layout_rules: Use a dark charcoal left sidebar on wide web layouts and an off-canvas sidebar below 900px.
Map every visible sidebar item to one complete top-level page view; show exactly one page at a time and never scroll between sidebar pages.
Use a white top bar with breadcrumb context above a cool gray page canvas.
Use four colorful KPI cards for the first-row operational summary.
Keep content within 1480px and use 24px desktop page padding.
Use flat white cards, light borders, compact controls, and restrained shadows.
Place order filters above a dense table and keep explicit visible field labels.
Open order details in a right-side drawer so the list context remains visible.
Confirm state-changing order actions in a modal before mutating mock data.

component_inventory.name: primary_navigation
component_inventory.use_for: five top-level web modules with mutually exclusive page views

component_inventory.name: page_view
component_inventory.use_for: complete pages and current location context

component_inventory.name: metric_card
component_inventory.use_for: color-coded operational indicators derived from current mock state

component_inventory.name: business_card
component_inventory.use_for: charts, ranked lists, forms, teams, and settings

component_inventory.name: data_table
component_inventory.use_for: orders, customers, and members with visible result counts

component_inventory.name: notification_panel
component_inventory.use_for: operational notices opened from the top bar

component_inventory.name: detail_drawer
component_inventory.use_for: order inspection and contextual state updates

component_inventory.name: modal_dialog
component_inventory.use_for: order status confirmation and member invitation

component_inventory.name: settings_switch
component_inventory.use_for: boolean preferences with explicit labels and descriptions

interaction_contracts: Every visible enabled control must have an observable result; omit unfinished controls or expose them as truly disabled with a reason.
All controls must be reachable and operable by keyboard.
The mobile sidebar toggle must synchronize aria-controls and aria-expanded.
Page navigation must synchronize aria-current, breadcrumb text, document title, and URL hash, reset content scroll, and preserve each page's local state.
Period switching must recalculate dashboard metrics and chart marks from one mock state.
Filtering must update the result count and an explicit empty state.
CSV export must create a nonempty file representing the current filtered mock state.
The drawer and dialogs must support Escape, cancel without mutation, focus containment, and focus restoration.
Order state changes must update the order row, drawer, overview metrics, and related summaries.
Settings save and reset must show the current persisted demo preference state.

preserve: dark charcoal sidebar plus light gray content canvas
violet primary actions and CoreUI-like semantic colors
flat bordered cards with compact controls and modest radii
colorful KPI cards with small inline trend graphics
filter plus table plus detail drawer workflow
replace_from_development_document: mock orders, customers, members, notifications, and settings
drawer fields, dialog forms, and feedback copy
avoid: CoreUI logos, brand names, screenshots, product copy, images, or upstream source code
CoreUI PRO components or any unverified commercial assets
external CSS, JavaScript, icon, font, image, or analytics dependencies
native desktop window chrome or operating-system app conventions
oversized gradients, glassmorphism, or highly rounded consumer-app cards
using color alone to communicate state
fake enabled controls or success messages without real state changes

single_file_compilation.style_source: inline the complete contents of tokens.css into a style element
single_file_compilation.script_source: inline the complete contents of interactions.js before the closing body tag
single_file_compilation.asset_policy: use inline SVG and CSS shapes only; do not introduce external URLs
